group_security_enabled_verification.raw_dataset_schema_limit: SharpHound v3 raw data does not collect groupType attribute; properties in raw JSON only include [description, name, objectid, highvalue, admincount, distinguishedname, domain].
group_security_enabled_verification.rationale: Declared as security_group=True because in Active Directory only security groups can be security principals in DACLs. If created as a mail-enabled security group, the ACE is valid; if purely a distribution group, DACL rights cannot propagate. This remains an unverified runtime assumption due to dataset schema limits.
